description: This file defines a shadow class for Android's AudioManager used in Robolectric tests, specifically for simulating audio effects in unit tests.

classes.name: ShadowAskAudioManager
classes.description: A Robolectric shadow class for Android's AudioManager, used for testing audio effects without actual hardware interaction.

methods.name: loadSoundEffects
methods.description: Simulates loading sound effects, sets internal flag to true.

methods.name: unloadSoundEffects
methods.description: Simulates unloading sound effects, sets internal flag to false.

methods.name: areSoundEffectsLoaded
methods.description: Returns whether sound effects are considered loaded.

methods.name: playSoundEffect
methods.description: Simulates playing a sound effect, records effect type and volume.

methods.name: getLastPlaySoundEffectVolume
methods.description: Returns the volume of the last played sound effect and resets the stored volume.

methods.name: getLastPlaySoundEffectType
methods.description: Returns the type of the last played sound effect and resets the stored effect type.
